enriched.title: Present Continuous e Vocabulário de Aposentadoria
enriched.summary: Esta aula aborda o uso do Present Continuous para descrever ações em progresso, situações temporárias, tendências e mudanças. Além disso, explora vocabulário relacionado à aposentadoria e ao varejo.
mainTopics: Formação de perguntas e respostas curtas

vocabulary.definition: An expression used to indicate an increasing degree or amount.
examples: The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.

vocabulary.definition: No longer working, usually due to age.
The period in life when one stops working permanently.
examples: She is planning for her retirement.

vocabulary.definition: To stop working, typically due to age.
The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption.

grammar.explanation: The Present Continuous tense is used to describe actions happening at the moment of speaking, temporary situations, ongoing events, and trends or changes.
rules: Formed with the verb 'to be' (am/is/are) + verb ending in -ing.
Use for actions happening now: 'I’m studying English now.'
Use for temporary situations: 'We’re living with my mother.'
Use for ongoing events: 'I’m finishing a project.'
Use for trends/changes: 'The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.'
examples: We’re living with my mother because we’re waiting for the keys to the new apartment.
I’m finishing a project with a big retail company.
The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.
commonMistakes: Omitting the verb 'to be': Incorrect - 'I working', Correct - 'I am working.'
Using the base form of the verb instead of -ing: Incorrect - 'She is work', Correct - 'She is working.'

practiceQuestions.question: Form a sentence: Liam / save / money / because he wants to buy a car.
practiceQuestions.answer: Liam is saving money because he wants to buy a car.
practiceQuestions.explanation: This sentence uses the Present Continuous to describe an ongoing action with a purpose.

practiceQuestions.question: Why / Henry / not train?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The question uses the Present Continuous negative form to ask for the reason behind the action.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate to English: O bebê está dormindo?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The question translates the Present Continuous form from Portuguese to English.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking cultures, retirement is often seen as an opportunity to pursue hobbies or travel, and there are various financial planning tools designed to prepare for this stage of life.
Retail is a major industry in many countries, and phrases like 'working in retail' are commonly used to describe jobs in stores or sales.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences in the Present Continuous by describing your current activities.
Use flashcards to memorize the vocabulary and include example sentences.
Listen to conversations or watch videos where the Present Continuous is used to recognize it in context.
originalExamples: The little girl is having ice cream with her older sister. (A menina está tomando sorvete com sua irmã mais velha.)
Liam is saving money because he wants to buy a car. (Liam está economizando dinheiro porque quer comprar um carro.)
You aren’t listening to me. (Você não está me ouvindo.)
My parents are looking for a new apartment. (Meus pais estão procurando um novo apartamento.)
The victim isn’t cooperating with the police. (A vítima não está cooperando com a polícia.)
Lucas and I are planning a trip to Japan. (Lucas e eu estamos planejando uma viagem ao Japão.)
I’m cooking fish for dinner. (Estou cozinhando peixe para o jantar.)
The water is boiling. You can put the pasta now. (A água está fervendo. Você pode colocar o macarrão agora.)
Henry isn’t training because he has health problems. (Henry não está treinando porque tem problemas de saúde.)
It isn’t raining now. We can go to the park. (Não está chovendo agora. Podemos ir ao parque.)
Is your father recovering well after the operation? (Seu pai está se recuperando bem após a operação?)
Are the engineers trying to find a solution? (Os engenheiros estão tentando encontrar uma solução?)
Is the baby sleeping? (O bebê está dormindo?)
Are we doing the right thing? (Estamos fazendo a coisa certa?)
